headline: Australian Lithium Stocks Slide Following Citi Forecast Cut on EV Battery Demand
summary: Shares of Australian lithium miners dropped after Citi reduced price forecasts due to weaker expected demand growth for electric vehicle batteries.
why: Australia is the leading producer of hard-rock lithium; raw material demand directly affects earnings and capital expenditure across global battery supply chains.
why_moved: Analyst price cuts and reduced battery demand projections prompted selling across Australian lithium mining equities.
